key_values.text: 數學及電算機科學學科類、資訊管理相關、工程學科類

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
1. Discuss and define the process with customer/users .
2. Coordinate with worldwide team to solve customer/user issues and Worldwide onsite support is essential.
3. Programming and troubleshooting.
4. MS.NET C# and SQL is necessary and B2B web Methods operation are plus.
5. Backend/ Frontend development is necessary.
6. Git,CI/CD, Cloud Programing skill are plus.
7. Pro-Active, Enthusiastic, Responsibility and Well Communicated .
8. English Email R/W .
Preferred qualifications:
1. Frontend web development skill. e.g. react/ vue/ angular...etc.
2. Python program skill.
3. Strongly positive self-learning new technology.
